objective: Apply the minimal AgentFlow V0 WriteLease V3 lifecycle correction. Preserve V2 process identity protections, but bind recovery to the actual workspace-writing OpenCode lifecycle: durably register worker PID/start-time/boot-id and isolated session/process-group before it can exec OpenCode; require controller, worker and writer group proven inactive before stale recovery; block release while owned writer lifecycle is active. Use only stdlib/Linux /proc. Add deterministic pipe-barrier and temp-dir fake-process tests. Do not modify client-app, run H1, Docker, database, or network operations.
invariants: Worker identity is atomically persisted under the lease guard before the wrapper receives GO and execs OpenCode.
Controller death before GO makes the wrapper exit without executing the worker command.
Controller dead plus original writer or writer group active remains an active lease; no archive or second writer.
Only controller, worker, and worker process-group all provably inactive makes a V3 lease stale.
Unknown writer or group liveness fails closed.
Normal release verifies owned writer lifecycle completion before token-safe unlink.
Preserve V2 boot/start-time/reuse, legacy fail-closed, archive uniqueness, and contender serialization protections.
Tests use only stdlib fake children and temporary directories.
